brief.goal: Cap my team's spending at 5000 LKR a week.

mustCover.must: Sets the team's weekly limit to 5000.00
Confirms the new limit back to the manager in LKR

mustNot.mustNot: Sets a per-category or per-employee limit instead of one team-wide amount
Invents an amount the manager did not state

brief.goal: I want to change my team's weekly budget, can you help?

mustCover.must: Asks for the new weekly amount rather than assuming one
Sets the team's weekly limit to 6500.00 once given the amount

mustNot.mustNot: Sets a limit before the manager has stated an amount
